positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created internal MVC framework and supporting libraries (routing, IoC Container, ORM, etc.) for
RESTful API service using PHP7.4 and MariaDB.
▪ Standardized local development environments and created staging and testing environments
using docker and docker-compose reducing environment inconsistencies and developer 
onboarding time. Developers were able to have a running environment with new code 
committed on their first day of hire.
▪ Created CI/CD pipeline automating testing, builds, and deployments using Serverless
Framework, GitHub Actions, bash scripting, docker, ansible etc. Reduced deployment time from 
at minimum 30 minutes for simple deployments to running a single command.
▪ Maintained a PHP based dialer system with Asterisk PBX with on average over 300k Outbound 
and 10k inbound calls daily developing AGIs, dial plans, and other general configuration and 
APIs/UIs within the dialer system.
▪ Oversaw and engineered the entire SDLC of a React site from conception to 
deployment and continuing maintenance that interacted with various APIs across the business 
org. Allowed for a centralized place for new proof of concept controls and controls for systems 
that previously had no UI and required developer support.
▪ Architected and developed AWS Python Lambda Serverless SASS Ring-less Voice Mail (RVM)
system used both internally and by clients delivering over 900K RVMs a month. The service 
interacted with internal and external APIs, and was built with API Gateway, RDS, IAM, AWS 
Secrets Manager, SQS, CloudWatch, Cloud Formation, GrayLog and other AWS services.
▪ Created a Python Lambda microservice application using API Gateway, DynamoDB, Amazon 
Cognito, S3 and Serverless Framework that interacted with Twilio and a React front end allowing 
for an automated procedure for external customers to record and hear and update their 
RVM messaging.
▪ Supervised junior developers delegating out work and timelines and 
mentored them in best practices and code reviews.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed sites through the entire development cycle including acting as project manager for clients using CI/CD (Jenkins), JIRA, Agile, TDD, PHP7, SASS/CSS, SQL, and JavaScript using frameworks such as Laravel and WordPress. Created a reporting system for clients that included dashboard analytics alongside monthly snapshots sent directly to the client. Owner of hosting & maintenance of sites and servers with duties including tracking contracts, system & web server configuration (NGINX) and error troubleshooting. Created and used RESTful APIs to interact with 3rd party services.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Working as a web developer consultant to Marketing For Change.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description: Created a reporting system for student applications and their source of Origin (e.g. Google Search, Google AdWords, Bing, Facebook Ads, etc.).

positions.title: Wireless Assistant
positions.description:
Managed, maintained, and expanded the wireless database systems and university websites.
Provided troubleshooting support campus wide for various wireless connectivity issues.
Competed scripting and programming assignments using Python, PHP, and Perl for various departments.
